verdict.rationale: Cactus ships its own CLI (`cactus run`, `cactus benchmark`), Python bindings and OpenAI-compatible engine APIs, and runs on Linux on Arm and x86 without a GPU. That implies GUI-free operation suitable for servers, but the docs never explicitly describe headless, server or CI deployment. missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless/server-daemon mode, CI pipeline usage guidance or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of server/CI deployments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines
